We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. Facts: Defendant Zhang claimed to rent a car, deceived victim Li and took his car. Then he mortgaged the car to friend Jiao and borrowed 15,000 RMB. Victim called to get car back, Zhang refused, then fled. This is fraud (骗取财物) and also possibly illegal seizure of vehicle? The act is deception to obtain property (car) and then use it as collateral. That is theft? Actually taking car by deception is "诈骗" (fraud) or "抢夺"? He didn't use force, just deception. So crime: "诈骗" (fraud). Also "非法占有他人财物" maybe "盗窃"? But theft requires taking property without consent, but here he obtained by deception, which is fraud. So the appropriate charge is "诈骗". In Chinese criminal law, "诈骗罪" is for obtaining property by deception. Also "非法占有" maybe "非法占有他人财物罪"? But typical is fraud. Also "非法转让、抵押他人车辆" maybe "非法转让、抵押他人财产" is part of fraud. So answer likely "诈骗". The examples show they list "拐卖妇女、儿童" etc. So we output single crime: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>.
